label: P10_G stacked cuts: B + rubber index in round 1, 36 m + labour index in round 2
hypothesis: Every cut Ravensteiner gives is per move or per NEW verified kind, but no game ever stacked them. Probe B (0.702) sent price history + should-cost in round 1 (open 31.50) and the 36-month move with NO data in round 2 (final 31.20, step 0.30; 'Which figures is that based on?'). Agents 53bab007 / c283f47d sent the labour index alone in round 2 ('Reflecting the minor index change', -0.20). G = B plus: the rubber index fall (-0.25%, 2026-01 -> 2026-02, verified like the labour one) as round 1's third claim, and the labour index together with the 36-month move in round 2. Record to beat: Codacabana 0.71 = 31.10 @ 56 d (EUR 428,374 saved). Predicted: round 1 open 31.30-31.50, round 2 final 30.80-31.20; <= 31.09 beats it.

rounds.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and for being open about your capacity situation.

We are ready to give you the firm commitment you asked for: a binding 23,400 pieces per year for 24 months, and we accept a longer lead time of 56 days so you can plan production.

Our orders for the 24 mm mechanical seal were at EUR 28.94 in 2023 and have been at EUR 29.89 since January 2024 (po:4500010364-10, po:4500010407-10, po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31 per piece (cost:340010).
Producer prices DE for other rubber products changed -0.3% from 2026-01 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-01, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-02).

We therefore propose to keep EUR 29.89 per piece, the price we have paid since January 2024.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your answer. We move towards you: we extend the commitment to 36 months, 70,200 pieces in total.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

We propose EUR 30.40 per piece.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you. To close, we propose EUR 30.80 per piece on the same 36-month, 56-day terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
